name: Charles Pashayan
bio: A Representative from California; born in Fresno, Fresno County, Calif., March 27, 1941; graduated from Bullard High School, 1959; B.A., Pomona College, Claremont, Calif., 1963; J.D., Hastings Law School, University of California, San Francisco, 1968; captain, United States Army, 1968-1970; admitted to the California bar in 1969 and to the U.S. Supreme Court bar in 1977; special assistant to General Counsel, United States Department of Health, Education, and Welfare, 1973-1975; B.Litt., Oxford University, England, 1977; elected as a Republican to the Ninety-sixth and to the five succeeding Congresses (January 3, 1979-January 3, 1991); unsuccessful candidate for reelection in 1990 to the One Hundred Second Congress; is a resident of Fresno, Calif.
